steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan.

In a large bowl, cream butter, white sugar and brown sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Fold in mashed banana. In a separate bowl, mix flour, baking powder and salt. Fold flour mixture into butter mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Spread in prepared pan.
Bake in preheated oven 20 minutes, until set. Cool before cutting into squares.

raw_recipe.headline: Banana Chocolate Chip Dessert
raw_recipe.description: These banana and chocolate chip bars are quick and easy.
raw_recipe.name: Banana Chocolate Chip Dessert

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease and flour a 10x15 inch jelly roll pan.

In a large bowl, cream butter, white sugar and brown sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg and vanilla. Fold in mashed banana. In a separate bowl, mix flour, baking powder and salt. Fold flour mixture into butter mixture. Stir in chocolate chips. Spread in prepared pan.
Bake in preheated oven 20 minutes, until set. Cool before cutting into squares.

review.reviewBody: I was wanting something a little healthy but not a bread since my husband doens't like banana bread, I tried this dessert and it was delicious! I did use 3/4 cup and 1 tablespoon of applesauce instead of butter and 3 egg whites instead of 1 egg. I also used 3 really ripe (almost black) bananas and lowered my sugar to 1/2 cup of each. I used a bar pan and the bars came out moist and more like a bar with a little cakey spring to it. My husband loved it and my son devoured his. Great recipe!
Great dessert! Added one extra egg and poured batter into 9”x13” greased Pyrex. Baked for 25 mins. Cooled and frosted with a butter cream frosting.

This was awesome!!! Everybody loved it- kids and adults alike. No need for whip cream or chocolate syrup either - perfect the way it was. I did use 1/4 cup of whole wheat flour and the rest white. I also used milk chocolate chips. And I did it all in the same bowl! Loved how quick it was to make AND bake!! I used my stoneware bar pan from Pampered chef and accidentally cooked it about 5 min too long, too, and it was still delicious!!

This was a perfect dessert for using up old bananas. It came out moist and dense (like a muffin). I stuck with the original recipe but cooked it in a 9x13 pan for an additional 10-15 mins (a recommendation from another reviewer.) When it was still warm out of the oven, I melted some more chocolate chips on the top, and sprinkled a layer of crystallized sugar which gave it a sweet, chocolatey crunch topping! I brought it to work the next day, and everyone DEVOURED it...I even passed the recipe on to others cause they enjoyed it so much! I'll definitely make this again :)

After eating like half the tray of this thing and making it multiple times I feel like I owe this recipe a review. MAKE THIS RIGHT NOW! This recipe is like a super moist, chewy banana cake with chocolate chips that doesn't need icing. The only downside is that each time you make it you'll eat at least half the pan in one sitting. My husband even goes back for more of these and he rarely eats dessert. 

I make it exactly as written except I use a 13x9 in pyrex dish, I prefer using mini chocolate chips, and I bake until a toothpick comes out clean in the center. If you like bananas and chocolate go preheat your oven !!!

I had some overripe bananas & didn't want to do a bread. I'm SO glad I tried this recipe. I used 4 bananas & cut down on the white sugar a bit, used a mix of light & dark brown sugar, a mix of dark & semi-sweet chips, and made it in a 9x13 for 35 minutes. No topping needed; it's perfect as is. Gave some to the snow plow guy & he enjoyed them so much, he said the next time is free - can't go wrong with that!

My god. This is fantastic! I added 1 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg, and before baking added a layer of crumbles (1/3 cup brown sugar, 1 tbsp butter, 1/4 tsp cinn, 2 tbsp flour) to the top. I also used a 9x13 pan so they took 28 minutes to fully cook. I am dreading my roommates coming home.. I know they will eat the whole thing by the time I am back from class!

Pretty good recipe I’d make again. I cooked it in an 11”x17” pan and still had to cook it about 5-7 minutes longer. (I’m in a high altitude location, so maybe that was why?) It’s a nice change from banana bread, but was just slightly bland on its own. I think adding chocolate/whipped cream would have been a nice addition. I’d probably make a cream, add some chocolate, and truly make it as a jelly roll next time.

Made it just like the recipe said (double batch) and it turned out perfect. Doubled all ingredients except used 3.5 tsp baking powder, 4 frozen peeled ripe bananas. Also had to bake it quite a bit longer than the time listed. Double batch made 4 ramekins, 2 dozen minicupcakes and 8x8 bar pan. My kids said it was their favorite new dessert.

These came out Great! I followed the recipe, only I used a little more than a cup and a half of bananas because I had to use them up. I also used the rest of the bag of chocolate chips and poured it over the top after it was done baking and spread it out when it melted as an icing. When it cooled I put it in the frig. and the next day they were awesome! My Grandson is gonna love these :)

The concept for this is excellent. One person said they thought that the chocolate may have ruined the dish for them, which I find strange as the two made a great combination. However, I did decide to use milk chocolate chips instead of the semi-sweet (tasted great).

Someone else said to use a tablespoon of vegetable oil - I tried it and it came out fine (some people had been saying the texture was a little like banana bread, mine wasn't).

Finally, the directed baking time was far less than what mine needed (this may have been because I put in about 1/4 c more banana - I like banana). When I pulled it out at about 20 minutes and the center was still jiggling, I bumped the temp down to 325 and it took roughly another 20 minutes or so before the center started to firm-up and brown. The results were delicious and my friends were all very pleased.

Just made this for the first time and it turned out really good. FYI: I didn't have a 10 x 15 jelly roll pan, so baked in a 9 x 15 pan. Needed to cook for 28 minutes instead of the 15 minutes for the jelly roll pan.

These were great for an easy, quick treat. I subbed 1/2 cup coconut oil and 1/4 cup plain greek yogurt for the butter and used 1/3 cup less sugar. I added a peanut butter glaze on top for extra flavor. Will keep this in my collection!

I didn’t have baking powder so substituted with baking soda and white vinegar as advised by Google! Also didn’t have the right pan so put it in a square Pyrex dish. This meant that the baking time took twice as long to get the middle to set, but resulted in a beautifully caramelised and crusty surface which I loved. Lovely recipe, great for a Sunday morning wake up!
Tasted not fully cooked.May need to cool more.

A combination of ingredients that you typically might find in a loaf of quick bread or cupcakes. I liked cutting them into bars, because there are times when all you really want are a few bites, and if you want more, eat two (or more). Baked up beautifully at 20 minutes using mini semisweet chocolate chips, what I had on hand. The bars are super moist from the bananas, and have just the right level of sweetness with just a dusting of confectioners sugar. Nice for adults with a cup of coffee or tea, or kids with a glass of milk.

Really enjoyed this recipe. I used a couple of "black" bananas. I had intended to bring them to a friend's house as a "dessert to share". However, there are only a couple left! (Baked in a 9 X 13 pan)

Love this recipe. It's my go-to for those slightly over-ripened (ok, black) bananas I never ate in time. I use about 1/2 cup more bananas and 1/2 cup of peanut butter chips extra. Never have a problem.
This is delicious. It makes a giant bar muffin. Perfect amount of sweetness. My family lines up as soon as it comes out of the oven.
Loved it! The family ate it up real quick. Put some powdered sugar on top after it cooled and it was amazing
